_about: Table view size calibration from Tiffany's real top-down photo (Nov 1 7:34pm): Sunday Mahjong 'Sunday' tiles + Sunday Mahjong 20in Tortoise acrylic racks on a Sunday Mahjong mat (rattan/cane border), shot straight down. Photo: assets/table-view/sizecheck/sunday-tiles-sunday-tortoise-20in-racks-rattan-mat-topdown.jpg (1932x2576). Measured by eye on the photo, approx +/-3%. Scale anchor = the 20in rack.
notes: Walls sit tight against the inside of each rack, centered, 19 tiles long (2 high). Racks are close to the mat edge on the sides and further in at top/bottom in this photo (hand placement, not a rule). Use: scale racks by R.len, walls by tile width x 19, mat by its listed size. Mat edge-to-edge measures ~31.6in at the rack scale vs the listed 33in Rattan mat: treat rack/wall/tile ratios as reliable (all measured in the same plane) and the mat ratio as +/-5% (stitched edge, lens).
